limits: This verifies preservation and current metadata/API validity, not a new complete browser run.
The thirty stages retain accepted_closest source-specific fidelity; generated side-view parallax does not establish absolute pixel-perfect1:1.
Three camera-only stages retain no invented idle weather or ambient motion.
No CQC core final suite was executed, and no source image/runtime/catalogue was modified.
